name: real_atomic
notes: Real Sysmon telemetry from two lab attack simulations in OTRF/Security-Datasets (github.com/OTRF/Security-Datasets, MIT license). Each source file records one atomic ATT&CK technique on its own lab host and timeframe; the two are merged into one capture (their ProcessGuid namespaces do not collide). Converted from OTRF's flat JSON export with scripts/adapt_otrf_capture.py; only Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational records with an EventID ingest.py understands (1/3/11/12/13/14) are kept. 127 lines were adapted; 8 are byte-identical duplicates in the source log, leaving 119 stored events. Ground truth in labels.json.
